name: Healthie AI Scribe
description: Healthie AI Scribe is a native AI documentation feature built into the Healthie EHR platform, not a standalone product. Available as add-on for Plus plans ($30/mo+) and above—add-on pricing not publicly disclosed. Generates structured, editable chart notes from telehealth sessions (via HIPAA-compliant Zoom integration) or in-person ambient sessions. Supports SOAP, ADIME, intake forms, and custom charting templates built within Healthie. Over 250,000 minutes of AI-assisted charting logged by Q4 2025 with 75% average reduction in documentation time. HIPAA/HITRUST/ONC certified. Best for practices already on Healthie wanting native AI without third-party integrations. Launched at FNCE 2025, general availability 2026.

faqs.q: How much does Healthie AI Scribe cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Healthie AI Scribe is an add-on for Plus plans ($30/mo) and above. The add-on pricing is not publicly disclosed—contact hello@gethealthie.com for a quote. You must have AI Charting enabled on your Healthie subscription.

faqs.q: Is Healthie AI Scribe available as a standalone product?
faqs.a: No. Healthie AI Scribe is built directly into the Healthie EHR platform and requires an existing Healthie subscription (Plus, Group, or Enterprise). For standalone AI scribes, consider Freed ($39-119/mo) or Carepatron (free tier available).

faqs.q: Is Healthie AI Scribe HIPAA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes. Healthie is HIPAA, HITRUST, and ONC certified. AI Scribe uses HIPAA-compliant Zoom integration for telehealth sessions. BAA available for covered entities.

faqs.q: What note types does Healthie AI Scribe support?
faqs.a: Healthie AI Scribe generates SOAP notes, ADIME notes, intake forms, progress notes, and any custom charting templates built within Healthie. It adapts to your existing template structure.

faqs.q: Healthie AI Scribe vs Freed: which is better?
faqs.a: Healthie AI Scribe is native to Healthie EHR—best if you're already on Healthie and want seamless integration. Freed ($39-119/mo) works with any EHR via copy-paste and has transparent pricing. For Healthie users, use Healthie's native scribe. For EHR flexibility, use Freed.
